name: audino
flavor: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

abilities.name: healer
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of curing each adjacent ally of any major status ailment after each turn.

abilities.name: regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.

abilities.name: klutz
abilities.effect: Prevents the Pokémon from using its held item in battle.
